description: Source code for the Runner component of a web testing framework, managing browser automation, state extraction, and property verification.

classes.name: Runner
classes.description: Manages browser testing sessions, including setup, execution, and teardown.

classes.name: RunnerOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for the Runner, such as stopping on violation.

classes.description: Enum representing control flow decisions during test execution.

classes.name: RunObserver

methods.description: Main loop executing browser events, state extraction, verification, and observer notifications.
